We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 1 reaction (i.e., one step) to synthesize the target molecule. The target SMILES is given with atom mapping: [CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]

Interpretation: It's a bicyclic? Actually it's a cyclopentane fused? Let's decode: There's an exocyclic alkene attached to a phenyl ring (c1ccccc1). The alkene carbon 2 attached to phenyl and to C@@H9 which is part of a cyclopentane ring with OH and CF3 group attached to carbon 15? Wait carbon 15 is attached to three Fs (CF3). So the target is a cyclopentanol with CF3 substituent, attached via a chiral carbon to an exocyclic alkene attached to phenyl.

The guidance mentions carbonyl-ene reaction: forward reaction is carbonyl-ene, which converts a carbonyl (ketone) and an alkene into an allylic alcohol (hydroxyl) and forms a new C-C bond, forming a five-membered ring. So retrosynthetically, we need to break the C-O bond (the OH) and the C-C bond formed, to get a ketone and an alkene precursor.

Thus the retrosynthetic step is the reverse of carbonyl-ene: we propose a precursor that is a ketone (maybe a cyclopentanone with CF3) and an alkene (maybe a phenyl-substituted alkene) that undergo intramolecular carbonyl-ene to give the product.

The template ID 1209837 matches this transformation: retro_smarts_template: [C:3]-[C:2](-[C:4])-[OH;D1;+0:1]>>C-C(=C)-C(=O)-[O;H0;D2;+0:1]-[C:2](-[C:3])-[C:4]

Interpretation: The forward reaction (right to left) is carbonyl-ene: a carbonyl (C=O) attached to O (maybe an ester?) Actually the forward: C-C(=C)-C(=O)-O-... Wait the template: product side (left) is [C:3]-[C:2](-[C:4])-[OH] (i.e., an allylic alcohol). Reactant side (right) is C-C(=C)-C(=O)-[O]... So the retro direction (our retrosynthesis) is breaking the allylic alcohol into a carbonyl and an alkene.

Thus we can use template 1209837 to generate precursors.

We need to apply the template to the target molecule to get precursors. Use apply_template with target SMILES and template_id 1209837.
